test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 6 @ $ 1 8 # 9 % ≺ 2 4 ⋟ 3 ^ 5 & 7 (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be sixth from the right?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 6 @ $ 1 8 # 9 % ≺ 2 4 ⋟ 3 ^ 5 & 7 (Right)

According to the question, all the numbers are dropped from the series:

(Left) **6** @ $ **1 8** # **9** % ≺ **2 4 **⋟ **3** ^ **5** & **7** (Right) ⇒ (Left) @ $ #&am
